name: English: Creative Writing
notes: Six courses, five of which must be taken while at the University of Rochester. No more than two courses in one's major may overlap with the minor.
The three remaining courses may be chosen from the department's writing offerings or from its 200- and 300-level literature offerings.

requirementGroups.label: Introductory creative writing (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two creative writing courses at the introductory level: ENGL 121: Creative Writing: Fiction; ENGL 122: Creative Writing: Poetry; ENGL 123: Playwriting; ENGL 125: Speculative Fiction

requirementGroups.label: Advanced creative writing
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: At least one advanced creative writing course: ENGL 275: Advanced Creative Writing: Fiction; ENGL 276: Advanced Creative Writing: Poetry; ENGL 277: Topics in Screenwriting; ENGL 281: Creative Nonfiction; ENGL 375: Seminar in Fiction Writing; ENGL 376: Seminar in Poetry Writing

requirementGroups.label: Writing or 200-300 level literature courses (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Additional courses can be chosen from the department's offerings in writing, or from its 200- and 300-level offerings in literature.
